notablePrerequisites:
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Patriar's Seal's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Selvala.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untapping Patriar's Seal.
Repeat.
 If you control a creature with power 6 or greater, this combo nets infinite colored mana, and you may untap any artifact(s) you control.
